question: By what factor does the Fe content (wt %) of the agglomerate neck exceed that of the silica sand?
rendered:
Table 3: EDS Analysis of the Elemental Composition of Silica Sand and Agglomerated Neck Structures

silica sand agglomerate
element  at.%  at.%
Na   0.50  38.31
P     0.25  56.44
Fe    0.001  2.37
Si   97.93  2.72

To find the factor by which the Fe content of the agglomerate neck exceeds that of the silica sand, divide the Fe content of the agglomerate neck by the Fe content of the silica sand:

2.37 / 0.001 = 2370
